title: Check-in
description: Log how you're feeling and see how it shifts over time.

today.title: Today
today.howAreYou: How are you feeling right now?

trend.emptyRange: Not enough check-ins in this range yet.

detail.title: Mood entry
detail.deleteError: Couldn't delete this entry. Try again.
detail.notFound: We couldn't find that mood entry.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this entry?
confirmDelete.message: This permanently removes the mood log. It can't be recovered.

welcome.title: Know your emotional weather
welcome.subtitle: A quick check-in, and a record you can look back through.

howToUse.title: How to log
howToUse.scaleBody: 1 is very low, 5 is very good - pick the number that fits how you feel right now.
howToUse.emotionsBody: Optional tags that add texture to the number.
howToUse.notesBody: Optional free-text - a trigger, a context, anything worth remembering.

whatYouSee.title: What you will see
whatYouSee.weekBody: The strip shows one week at a time. Move between weeks, and tap a day to read what you logged.
whatYouSee.chartsBody: A line for how the score moves, and columns for how often each level came up. Both read the range you pick.
whatYouSee.historyBody: Every check-in you have logged sits on its own screen, newest first.

heatmap.title: All time
heatmap.empty: Log a mood to start your map.

allHistory.title: All history
allHistory.description: Every check-in you have logged, newest first.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.description: Your check-ins will collect here as you log them.

error.title: Couldn't load your history
error.description: Check your connection and try again - nothing has been lost.
